purpose: Read-only color shift diagnostic; no inference, training or correction

methods.regions: Fixed input encoded Yprime=.2126R+.7152G+.0722B; dark<.2 bright>.7
methods.relative_RGB: per-pixel encoded RGB divided by R+G+B; mean of ratios, not ratio of means
methods.red_blue: pR-pB; positive change means relative redward shift, not color temperature
methods.neutral: input Yprime>=.02 and max(pR,pG,pB)-min(pR,pG,pB)<=.05; declared diagnostic cutoffs, not tuned; not a neutral-object annotation
methods.saturation: Main statistics exclude any 255 channel in ANY compared image, common mask per full-image pair or four-column ROI; all-black excluded; channel zero alone retained; separate inclusive delta means provided
methods.Lab: Assumed sRGB IEC transfer and D65 white; no camera/ICC calibration; XYZ matrix and white constants as code; Lab includes lightness-dependent changes
methods.interpretation: delta a*>0 redward; delta b*>0 yellowward. DeltaE76 is descriptive difference, not error without normal-light GT
methods.limits: B1 full frames not saved: extra B1 color shifts only assessed in 12 fixed ROI from 4 images; ROI overlap can double-count pooled pixels; no extrapolation to all 8 dev
